_comment: Hand-measured mattress bounds for FLOOR_PLAN_03.png, in ORIGINAL image pixels (1042x1642), corners not centres. Read off the drawing at 2x with a 20px ruler: the mattress rectangle only, excluding the two nightstands either side of the headboard. pxPerFt is DERIVED, not printed on the plan — the bed measures 236 x 265px, which is 1800 x 2000mm at 40 px/ft, and the bedroom door swing puts a 900mm leaf at ~37 px/ft. Treat it as +/- 8% and replace it the moment you have a dimension off the real drawing.
